prospectiveLock.rule: This contract, its row mapping, cycle state machine, trigger authority and output boundary must be merged before any BW6.4 cycle may qualify. Pull-request, push and local executions are validation-only.

authorityBoundary.purpose: Exercise the frozen R2 point-weight table against the active Graham week in a read-only side-by-side shadow and accumulate execution-stability evidence only.

inputContract.currentNumbersPathRule: Resolve data/walters/nfl/{season}/week-{WW}-current-numbers.json from the governed active-week manifest and validate exact season/week identity.
semanticFieldsForbidden: market price, limit, movement, edge or value field
QB, personnel, matchup, overlay or component field

snapshotIdentity.algorithm: SHA-256 of RFC8785-style canonical JSON containing only season, week, activeWeekSha256, currentNumbersSha256 and semanticFairBoardSha256.
snapshotIdentity.distinctSnapshotRule: A qualifying cycle's snapshot digest must differ from every cycle in the current clean streak.

grahamRowMapping.displayVerification: The stored displayed fair must equal the exact fair under the existing Graham function Math.round((value + Number.EPSILON) * 2) / 2, with negative zero normalized to zero.
grahamRowMapping.favoriteOrientation: Use the absolute displayed Graham fair solely as a row locator. Negative means HOME favorite, positive means AWAY favorite, and zero means PICK.
grahamRowMapping.integerRule: Absolute integer N identifies exact-margin row N.
grahamRowMapping.halfPointRule: Absolute N.5 identifies the two adjacent exact-margin rows N and N+1; retain only rows 1 through 18 and record every excluded boundary explicitly.
grahamRowMapping.pickRule: PICK identifies no supported BW6 exact-margin row and must remain an explicit fail-closed game result.
grahamRowMapping.unsupportedRule: A row outside 1 through 18, including the zero boundary, has no Stage 2 or R2 authority and remains explicit fail-closed. No interpolation, extrapolation or cross-zero calculation is permitted.

allowedOutput.comparisonRule: For each supported relevant row, show BOOK-EXACT, Stage 2 and Stage 3R2 point weights and fair half-point costs side by side without calculating an edge, preference, threshold or recommendation.

cyclePlan.cyclePurpose: Execution stability only; cycles do not provide statistical calibration or production authority.
cyclePlan.acceptedWindowRule: Evaluate the trailing three consecutive qualifying clean cycles. They must occupy three distinct America/Vancouver dates, include at least two genuine first-attempt schedule events, contain three distinct input snapshot digests and contain at least one transition where the active-week or current-numbers raw SHA-256 changes.
cyclePlan.initialCycleRule: The first clean cycle establishes the prospective baseline and need not demonstrate a prior input change.
cyclePlan.duplicateInputRule: A duplicate input attempt is CLEAN_NONQUALIFYING_DUPLICATE and does not reset the clean streak because no cycle begins.
cyclePlan.sameDateRule: An attempt after a qualifying cycle on the same Pacific date is CLEAN_NONQUALIFYING_SAME_DATE and does not reset the clean streak because no cycle begins.
cyclePlan.failureRule: Any begun cycle that is failed, incomplete, cancelled after its durable START receipt, nondeterministic, unpublished, missing a required receipt, based on changed governing code/model hashes or mutates a protected artifact resets the consecutive clean count to zero.

triggerAuthority.scheduledPurpose: Run after the 18:15 Pacific publication window while the Week 1 gate is active.
triggerAuthority.scheduledClassification: Only event_name=schedule with run_attempt=1 is SCHEDULED.
triggerAuthority.scheduledRerunClassification: A schedule rerun with run_attempt greater than 1 is MANUAL_EQUIVALENT and cannot satisfy the minimum scheduled count.

attemptLifecycle.startReceiptRule: A qualifying candidate attempt first publishes an immutable START receipt and sets the derived current state to INCOMPLETE_RESET before calculation. The receipt binds source commit, protected hashes, input hashes, run provenance and prior clean streak.
attemptLifecycle.completionRule: Only a validated immutable snapshot plus immutable result may close START as CLEAN_QUALIFYING. A missing completion remains INCOMPLETE_RESET and the streak stays zero.
attemptLifecycle.publicationCollisionRule: Never pull, rebase or recompute an in-flight attempt against moving main. A rejected fast-forward publication leaves the START receipt incomplete and resets the streak.

releaseFreezeRule: The initial BW6.4 current state records the SHA-256 of every release artifact. Every begun attempt must match that release manifest; any code, contract, validator, test or workflow change resets the streak and requires a new governed release.
dynamicProtectedArtifacts: resolved active-week personnelLedger path when present
protectedArtifactRule: Hash every listed and dynamically resolved protected artifact as opaque bytes immediately before and after a begun attempt and require equality. The hashes are runtime evidence, not a requirement that moving production files equal their historical R2 issuance bytes.
prohibitedOutputConcepts: BET, LEAN, WAIT or PASS mutation
nextGate: After a qualifying three-cycle window, conduct a separate prospective-outcome review. No downstream or production authority is implied.
